CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.aquarium_state()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_uid uuid:=auth.uid();
begin
 if v_uid is null then raise exception 'AUTH_REQUIRED'; end if;
 insert into public.player_aquariums(user_id) values(v_uid) on conflict do nothing;
 insert into public.aquarium_tanks(user_id,background_id,is_default)
 select v_uid,background_id,true from public.player_aquariums where user_id=v_uid
 on conflict(user_id) where is_default do nothing;
 return jsonb_build_object(
 'background',(select background_id from public.aquarium_tanks where user_id=v_uid order by display_order,created_at,id limit 1),
 'tanks',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by t.display_order,t.created_at,t.id) from public.aquarium_tanks t where user_id=v_uid),'[]'::jsonb),
 'inhabitants',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(c)||jsonb_build_object('species',app_private.species_payload(c.species_id,c.map_region_id)) order by c.acquired_at,c.id)
   from public.player_collectibles c join public.collectible_species s on s.id=c.species_id
   where c.user_id=v_uid and c.sold_at is null and c.escrow_gift_id is null and c.tank_id is not null and s.kind in ('fish','trash','decoration')),'[]'::jsonb),
 'storageCount',(select count(*) from public.player_collectibles c join public.collectible_species s on s.id=c.species_id
   where c.user_id=v_uid and c.sold_at is null and c.escrow_gift_id is null and c.tank_id is null and s.kind in ('fish','trash','decoration')),
 'tankCapacity',coalesce((select capacity from app_private.player_aquarium_capacity where user_id=v_uid),50),
 'nextCapacityExpansion',(select case c when 50 then jsonb_build_object('capacity',70,'price',5000) when 70 then jsonb_build_object('capacity',100,'price',10000) else null end from (select coalesce((select capacity from app_private.player_aquarium_capacity where user_id=v_uid),50) c) q),'tankPrice',350,
 'owned',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(background_id) from public.owned_aquarium_backgrounds where user_id=v_uid),'[]'::jsonb),
 'catalog',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) order by b.price) from public.aquarium_backgrounds b));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.arcade_weekly_rankings(p_game text, p_week_start date)
 RETURNS TABLE(rank bigint, user_id uuid, run_id uuid, score integer, elapsed_ms bigint, moves integer, finished_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with bounds as (
  select p_week_start::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' a,(p_week_start+7)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' b
 ), attempts as (
  select s.user_id,s.id run_id,s.score,null::bigint elapsed_ms,null::integer moves,s.finished_at,-s.score::bigint metric
  from public.shadow_game_runs s,bounds
  where p_game='shadow' and s.finished_at>=bounds.a and s.finished_at<bounds.b
  union all
  select m.user_id,m.id,null::integer,m.elapsed_ms,m.moves,m.finished_at,m.elapsed_ms
  from public.memory_game_runs m,bounds
  where p_game='memory' and m.finished_at>=bounds.a and m.finished_at<bounds.b
  and m.abandoned_at is null and m.elapsed_ms is not null
 ), best as (
  select distinct on(user_id) * from attempts order by user_id,metric,finished_at,run_id
 )
 select row_number() over(order by best.metric,best.finished_at,best.run_id),best.user_id,best.run_id,best.score,best.elapsed_ms,best.moves,best.finished_at from best
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.challenge_title_metrics(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with logs as materialized (
 select *, (occurred_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date play_day from app_private.title_fishing_log where user_id=p_user and source='manual'
), runs as materialized (
 select *,count(*) over w12 n12,count(*) over w5 n5,count(*) over w3 n3,count(*) over w2 n2,count(*) over w7 n7,
 bool_and(coalesce(kind='fish' and species_id is not null,false)) over w12 fish12,
 bool_and(coalesce(kind='fish' and species_id is not null and rarity in ('rare','epic','mythic'),false)) over w5 rare5,
 bool_and(coalesce(kind='fish' and species_id is not null and rarity in ('epic','mythic'),false)) over w3 epic3,
 bool_and(coalesce(kind='fish' and species_id is not null and rarity='mythic',false)) over w2 mythic2,
 bool_and(coalesce(kind='trash' and species_id is not null,false)) over w7 trash7
 from logs window
 w12 as (order by occurred_at,id rows between 11 preceding and current row),
 w5 as (order by occurred_at,id rows between 4 preceding and current row),
 w3 as (order by occurred_at,id rows between 2 preceding and current row),
 w2 as (order by occurred_at,id rows between 1 preceding and current row),
 w7 as (order by occurred_at,id rows between 6 preceding and current row)
), fish as materialized (select * from logs where kind='fish' and species_id is not null),
 days as materialized (
 select play_day,count(distinct kind) filter(where kind in ('fish','trash','decoration') and species_id is not null) kinds,
 count(distinct rarity) filter(where kind='fish' and species_id is not null) grades from logs group by play_day
), deliveries as materialized (
 select o.items from app_private.merchant_deliveries d join app_private.merchant_orders o on o.id=d.order_id where d.user_id=p_user and o.completed_at is not null and o.completed_by=d.user_id
), harbor as materialized (
 select result from public.harbor_voyages where user_id=p_user and claimed_at is not null
)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'challenge_manual',(select count(*) from logs),
 'challenge_days',(select count(distinct play_day) from logs),
 'challenge_fish12',(select count(*) from runs where n12=12 and fish12),
 'challenge_rare5',(select count(*) from runs where n5=5 and rare5),
 'challenge_epic3',(select count(*) from runs where n3=3 and epic3),
 'challenge_mythic2',(select count(*) from runs where n2=2 and mythic2),
 'challenge_trash7',(select count(*) from runs where n7=7 and trash7),
 'challenge_same_fish',coalesce((select max(n) from (select count(*) n from fish group by species_id) q),0),
 'challenge_unique',(select count(distinct species_id) from fish),
 'challenge_mythic_seas',(select count(distinct region_id) from fish where rarity='mythic'),
 'challenge_mythic_baits',(select count(distinct bait_id) from fish where rarity='mythic'),
 'challenge_rainbow_days',(select count(*) from days where grades=4),
 'challenge_rare_unique',(select count(distinct species_id) from fish where rarity='rare'),
 'challenge_epic_unique',(select count(distinct species_id) from fish where rarity='epic'),
 'challenge_mythic_unique',(select count(distinct species_id) from fish where rarity='mythic'),
 'challenge_crumbs',(select count(*) from fish where bait_id='bait_shell_crumbs' and rarity='rare'),
 'challenge_pupa',(select count(*) from fish where bait_id='bait_firefly_pupa' and rarity='epic'),
 'challenge_lightning',(select count(*) from fish where bait_id='bait_lightning_stardust' and rarity='epic'),
 'challenge_wax',(select count(*) from fish where bait_id='bait_starlight_wax' and rarity='mythic'),
 'challenge_star',(select count(*) from fish where bait_id='bait_cracked_star' and rarity='mythic'),
 'challenge_cloud',(select count(*) from fish where bait_id='bait_cloud_dough' and rarity='common'),
 'challenge_worm',(select count(*) from fish where bait_id='bait' and rarity='mythic'),
 'challenge_last_mythic',(select count(*) from fish where last_bait and rarity='mythic'),
 'challenge_buffet_days',(select count(*) from days where kinds=3),
 'challenge_deliveries',(select count(*) from deliveries),
 'challenge_delivery_species',(select count(distinct a->>'speciesId') from deliveries cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(items) a),
 'challenge_delivery_mythic',(select count(*) from deliveries where exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(items) a where a->>'rarity'='mythic')),
 'challenge_harbor',(select count(*) from harbor),
 'challenge_harbor_pair',(select count(*) from harbor where (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(result->'items','[]'::jsonb)) a where a->'species'->>'kind'='fish' and a->'species'->>'rarity'='mythic')>=2)
)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.enqueue_expiring_production_push()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer; stamp timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
begin
 with runs as (
  select s.id,s.user_id,s.started_at,s.expires_at,'production-expiring'::text category,'/production'::text path,
   '연료 보관 만료가 얼마 남지 않았어요!'::text title,
   f.name||'의 연료 보관이 약 5분 뒤 끝나요. 만료 전에 수령해 주세요.' body
  from app_private.production_sites s join public.production_facilities f on f.id=s.facility_id
  where s.started_at is not null and s.completes_at<=stamp and s.expires_at>stamp and s.expires_at<=stamp+interval '5 minutes'
  union all
  select s.id,s.user_id,s.started_at,s.expires_at,'bait-production-expiring','/bait-production',
   '미끼가 상하기 전에 받아 주세요!',f.name||'의 미끼 보관이 약 5분 뒤 끝나요. 상하기 전에 수령해 주세요.'
  from app_private.bait_production_sites s join public.bait_production_facilities f on f.id=s.facility_id
  where s.started_at is not null and s.completes_at<=stamp and s.expires_at>stamp and s.expires_at<=stamp+interval '5 minutes'
 )
 insert into app_private.push_deliveries(subscription_id,category,source_id,source_started_at,payload,expires_at)
 select d.id,r.category,r.id,r.started_at,
  jsonb_build_object('userId',r.user_id,'title',r.title,'body',r.body,'url',r.path,'tag',r.category||':'||r.id||':'||r.started_at,'expiresAt',r.expires_at),r.expires_at
 from runs r join app_private.push_subscriptions d on d.user_id=r.user_id and r.category=any(d.categories)
 where not exists(select 1 from app_private.push_deliveries q where q.subscription_id=d.id and q.category=r.category and q.source_id=r.id and q.source_started_at=r.started_at)
 order by r.expires_at,r.id,d.id limit 500
 on conflict(subscription_id,category,source_id,source_started_at) where category in ('production-expiring','bait-production-expiring') do nothing;
 get diagnostics n=row_count;return n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.exchange_state(p_tab text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_query text DEFAULT ''::text, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_uid uuid:=auth.uid();v_rows jsonb;v_total integer;
begin
 if v_uid is null then raise exception 'AUTH_REQUIRED';end if;
 if p_tab is null or p_tab not in ('all','mine') or p_query is null or char_length(p_query)>80 or p_offset is null or p_offset<0 then raise exception 'INVALID_EXCHANGE';end if;
 select count(*) into v_total from public.exchange_listings l
 where (case when p_tab='mine' then l.owner_id=v_uid else l.status='active' and l.side='sell' end)
 and l.side='sell' and l.offer->>'kind' in ('collectible','bait','fuel') and l.wanted->>'kind'='gold' and l.wanted->>'id'='gold'
 and (coalesce(l.title,'') ilike '%'||p_query||'%' or l.offer->>'name' ilike '%'||p_query||'%' or l.wanted->>'name' ilike '%'||p_query||'%');
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) order by q.created_at desc,q.id),'[]') into v_rows from(
  select l.*,(select p.avatar_path from public.player_profiles p where p.id=l.owner_id) as owner_avatar_path,
   (select count(*) from public.exchange_listing_likes s where s.listing_id=l.id) as like_count,
   (select count(*) from public.exchange_listing_comments c where c.listing_id=l.id) as comment_count
  from public.exchange_listings l
  where (case when p_tab='mine' then l.owner_id=v_uid else l.status='active' and l.side='sell' end)
  and l.side='sell' and l.offer->>'kind' in ('collectible','bait','fuel') and l.wanted->>'kind'='gold' and l.wanted->>'id'='gold'
  and (coalesce(l.title,'') ilike '%'||p_query||'%' or l.offer->>'name' ilike '%'||p_query||'%' or l.wanted->>'name' ilike '%'||p_query||'%')
  order by l.created_at desc,l.id limit 20 offset p_offset
 ) q;
 return jsonb_build_object('items',v_rows,'total',v_total);
end;

   'period',case when b.effect_kind = 'day_night' then case when b.is_night then 'night' else 'day' end else null end,
   'common_bp',case when b.is_night then b.night_common_bp else b.common_bp end,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.hall_of_fame()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'AUTH_REQUIRED';end if;
 with participants as materialized (
  select p.id,p.nickname,p.avatar_path,p.created_at from public.player_profiles p
  join auth.users u on u.id=p.id where lower(coalesce(u.email,''))<>'1@1.com'
 ), logs as materialized (
  select l.user_id,l.id,l.occurred_at,l.source,l.kind,l.rarity,l.species_id
  from app_private.title_fishing_log l join participants p on p.id=l.user_id
 ), catches as materialized (
  select user_id,kind,rarity from logs where species_id is not null
  union all
  select v.user_id,item->'species'->>'kind',item->'species'->>'rarity'
  from public.harbor_voyages v join participants p on p.id=v.user_id
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v.result->'items','[]'::jsonb)) item
  where v.claimed_at is not null
 ), manual as materialized (
  select *, (occurred_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date play_day,
   row_number() over(partition by user_id order by occurred_at,id)
   -row_number() over(partition by user_id,(species_id is not null) order by occurred_at,id) run
  from logs where source='manual'
 ), fishing as (
  select user_id,count(*) attempts,count(*) filter(where species_id is null) failures,
   count(*) filter(where species_id is not null and rarity='mythic') mythic
  from manual group by user_id
 ), totals as (
  select user_id,count(*) filter(where kind='fish') fish,
   count(*) filter(where rarity='mythic') mythic,
   count(*) filter(where kind='decoration') decorations from catches group by user_id
 ), daily as (
  select user_id,play_day,count(*) n from manual group by user_id,play_day
 ), runs as (
  select user_id,max(n) filter(where success) success,max(n) filter(where not success) failure
  from (select user_id,species_id is not null success,run,count(*) n
   from manual group by user_id,(species_id is not null),run) s group by user_id
 ), games as materialized (
  select user_id,'brick_plays'::text game from public.brick_game_runs
  union all select user_id,'shadow_plays' from public.shadow_game_runs
  union all select user_id,'memory_plays' from public.memory_game_runs
  union all select user_id,'odd_even_plays' from public.odd_even_runs
  union all select user_id,'ladder_plays' from app_private.ladder_runs
 ), arcade as (
  select user_id,sum(delta::bigint) filter(where delta>0) earned,
   -sum(delta::bigint) filter(where delta<0) spent
  from public.gold_transactions where item_id like 'arcade:%' group by user_id
 ), sales as (
  select case when side='sell' then owner_id else taker_id end user_id
  from public.exchange_listings where status='completed'
 ), purchases as (
  select case when side='sell' then taker_id else owner_id end user_id
  from public.exchange_listings where status='completed'
 ), reactions as materialized (
  select c.author_id user_id,r.value from app_private.hall_section_comment_reactions r
  join app_private.hall_section_comments c on c.id=r.comment_id where r.user_id<>c.author_id
  union all
  select target_id user_id,value from app_private.hall_reactions
  union all
  select coalesce(c.author_id,p.author_id),r.value from public.board_reactions r
  join public.board_posts p on p.id=r.post_id left join public.board_comments c on c.id=r.comment_id
  where r.user_id<>coalesce(c.author_id,p.author_id) and (r.comment_id is null or not c.deleted)
 ), helps as (
  select visitor_id user_id from public.aquarium_feedings where completed_at is not null and visitor_id<>owner_id
  union all select visitor_id from public.aquarium_cleanings where completed_at is not null and visitor_id<>owner_id
  union all select helper_id from app_private.expedition_boosts
 ), metrics as (
  select user_id,'casts' key,attempts::numeric value from fishing
  union all select user_id,'fish',fish from totals
  union all select d.user_id,'collection',100.0*count(*)/greatest((select count(*) from public.collectible_species where kind<>'map'),1)
   from public.player_discoveries d join public.collectible_species s on s.id=d.species_id where s.kind<>'map' group by d.user_id
  union all select user_id,'mythic',mythic from totals
  union all select user_id,'mythic_rate',100.0*mythic/attempts from fishing where attempts>=100
  union all select user_id,'failure_rate',100.0*failures/attempts from fishing where attempts>=100
  union all select sender_id,'gifts',count(*) from public.collectible_gifts
   where source='friend' and sender_id<>recipient_id group by sender_id
  union all select user_id,'sales',count(*) from sales group by user_id
  union all select user_id,'purchases',count(*) from purchases group by user_id
  union all select user_id,'titles',count(*) from public.player_titles group by user_id
  union all select visitor_id,'cleanings',count(*) from public.aquarium_cleanings
   where completed_at is not null and visitor_id<>owner_id group by visitor_id
  union all select visitor_id,'feedings',count(*) from public.aquarium_feedings
   where completed_at is not null and visitor_id<>owner_id group by visitor_id
  union all select user_id,'voyages',count(*) from public.harbor_voyages group by user_id
  union all select user_id,'games',count(*) from games group by user_id
  union all select user_id,game,count(*) from games group by user_id,game
  union all select user_id,'arcade_earned',earned from arcade
  union all select user_id,'arcade_spent',spent from arcade
  union all select user_id,'decorations',decorations from totals
  union all select p.user_id,'control_miss',count(*) from app_private.prepared_fishing_casts p
   where p.finished_at is not null and p.result->>'failure_reason'='minigame' group by p.user_id
  union all select user_id,'daily',max(n) from daily group by user_id
  union all select user_id,'failure_run',failure from runs
  union all select user_id,'trash',count(*) from manual where kind='trash' group by user_id
  union all select user_id,'likes',count(*) from reactions where value=1 group by user_id
  union all select user_id,'dislikes',count(*) from reactions where value=-1 group by user_id
  union all select user_id,'helps',count(*) from helps group by user_id
 ), ranked as (
  select m.*,p.nickname,p.avatar_path,row_number() over(partition by key order by value desc,p.created_at,p.id) rank
  from metrics m join participants p on p.id=m.user_id where m.value>0
 ), grouped as (
  select key,jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',user_id,'level',app_private.player_level(user_id),'levelProgress',app_private.player_level_progress(user_id),'nickname',nickname,'avatar_path',avatar_path,'value',value,'rank',rank) order by rank) rows
  from ranked where rank<=5 group by key
 ) select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(key,rows),'{}'::jsonb) into result from grouped;
 return jsonb_build_object('rankings',result,'generatedAt',statement_timestamp());
end $function$

AS $function$

begin
 with due as (
  select id from app_private.production_sites
  where started_at is not null and ready_notified_at is null
   and completes_at<=clock_timestamp() and expires_at>clock_timestamp()
   and (p_site_id is null or id=p_site_id)
  order by completes_at,id limit 500 for update skip locked
 ), marked as (
  update app_private.production_sites s set ready_notified_at=clock_timestamp()
  from due where s.id=due.id returning s.*
 ) insert into public.notifications(recipient_id,category,kind,title,body,production_site_id,production_started_at)
 select s.user_id,'general','system','연료 생산이 끝났어요!',
  f.name||'에서 연료 '||s.run_output||'개를 만들었어요. 생산소에서 수령해 주세요.',s.id,s.started_at
 from marked s join public.production_facilities f on f.id=s.facility_id
 on conflict(production_site_id,production_started_at) where production_site_id is not null do nothing;
 get diagnostics n=row_count;
 return n;
end $function$

begin

 select count(distinct user_id) into v_total from public.odd_even_runs where stage='banked';

  select row_number() over(order by r.stake desc,r.finished_at,r.id)+p_offset as rank,r.id,r.stake as gold,r.wins,
   coalesce(p.nickname,'섬 여행자') as nickname,r.user_id=auth.uid() as mine,

   r.user_id as "userId",p.friend_code as "friendCode",

    and ((f.sender_id=auth.uid() and f.recipient_id=r.user_id) or (f.recipient_id=auth.uid() and f.sender_id=r.user_id))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.pick_habitat_group(p_ids text[], p_region text, p_rod_region text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_home_multiplier numeric DEFAULT 1, p_rarity_fallback boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with candidates as materialized (
  select s.id,s.rarity,s.native_region_id,
   case when not s.is_native then 'shared' when s.native_region_id=p_region then 'home' else 'away' end bucket
  from public.collectible_species s where app_private.collectible_available_at(s.id,statement_timestamp()) and s.id=any(p_ids)
 ), groups as materialized (
  select distinct bucket from candidates
 ), selected as materialized (
  select bucket from groups
  order by -ln(greatest(random(),1e-15))/case bucket
   when 'home' then 25*greatest(p_home_multiplier,0.001)*case when p_rod_region=p_region then 1.1 else 1 end
   when 'shared' then 80 else 5 end,bucket limit 1
 )
 select c.id from candidates c join selected g using(bucket)
 order by -ln(greatest(random(),1e-15))/(
  case when c.bucket='away' and c.native_region_id=p_rod_region then 3 else 1 end
  *case when p_rarity_fallback then case c.rarity when 'common' then 7700 when 'rare' then 2000 when 'epic' then 270 else 30 end else 1 end
 ),c.id limit 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.player_levels(p_ids uuid[], p_friend_codes text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'AUTH_REQUIRED';end if;
 if p_ids is null or cardinality(p_ids)>100 or p_friend_codes is null or cardinality(p_friend_codes)>100 then raise exception 'INVALID_PLAYER_IDS';end if;
 -- Authorize the displayed identity before reading private progression. A
 -- profile UUID alone is never sufficient. Match existing display visibility.
 return coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('userId',p.id,'level',app_private.player_level(p.id),'levelProgress',app_private.player_level_progress(p.id)) order by p.id)
 from public.player_profiles p where p.id=any(p_ids) and (
  p.id=auth.uid()
  or p.friend_code=any(p_friend_codes)
  or exists(select 1 from public.friend_requests f where f.status in ('pending','accepted') and ((f.sender_id=auth.uid() and f.recipient_id=p.id) or(f.recipient_id=auth.uid() and f.sender_id=p.id)))
  or exists(select 1 from public.exchange_listings l where l.owner_id=p.id and l.side='sell' and (l.status in ('active','completed') or l.owner_id=auth.uid()))
  or exists(select 1 from public.exchange_listing_comments c join public.exchange_listings l on l.id=c.listing_id where c.user_id=p.id and l.side='sell' and (l.status in ('active','completed') or l.owner_id=auth.uid()))
  or exists(select 1 from public.board_posts b where b.author_id=p.id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.board_comments c where c.author_id=p.id and not c.deleted)
  or exists(select 1 from public.bug_reports b where b.author_id=p.id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.suggestion_posts s where s.author_id=p.id and (not s.friends_only or s.author_id=auth.uid() or (select app_private.notice_is_operator()) or exists(select 1 from public.friend_requests f where f.status='accepted' and ((f.sender_id=auth.uid() and f.recipient_id=s.author_id) or(f.recipient_id=auth.uid() and f.sender_id=s.author_id)))))
  or exists(select 1 from public.fishing_showcase_posts s where s.author_id=p.id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.fishing_showcase_reactions r join public.fishing_showcase_posts s on s.id=r.post_id where r.user_id=p.id)
  or exists(select 1 from public.collectible_gifts g where not g.exchange_hold and (g.sender_id=auth.uid() or g.recipient_id=auth.uid()) and p.id in (g.sender_id,g.recipient_id))
  or exists(select 1 from app_private.hall_comments c where c.author_id=p.id)
  or exists(select 1 from app_private.hall_section_comments c where c.author_id=p.id)
 )),'[]'::jsonb);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.rare_title_metrics(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with manual as materialized (
 select l.*,s.native_region_id,s.is_native,e.first_discovery,e.last_mythic_discovery,e.native_collection_complete
 from app_private.title_fishing_log l join public.collectible_species s on s.id=l.species_id
 left join app_private.title_acquisition_evidence e on e.collectible_id=l.collectible_id and e.user_id=l.user_id
 where l.user_id=p_user and l.source='manual'
), harbor as materialized (
 select v.region_id,v.vessel_id,v.vessel_snapshot->>'catch_bait_id' bait_id,item->'species'->>'id' species_id,
 s.native_region_id,s.is_native,e.first_discovery
 from public.harbor_voyages v cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v.result->'items','[]'::jsonb)) item
 join public.collectible_species s on s.id=item->'species'->>'id'
 left join app_private.title_acquisition_evidence e on e.collectible_id=(item->>'id')::uuid and e.user_id=v.user_id
 where v.user_id=p_user and v.claimed_at is not null
), conch as (
 select species_id from manual where bait_id='bait_first_greeting' and first_discovery
 union select species_id from harbor where bait_id='bait_first_greeting' and first_discovery
 union select l.species_id from app_private.title_fishing_log l
 join app_private.title_acquisition_evidence e on e.collectible_id=l.collectible_id and e.user_id=l.user_id
 where l.user_id=p_user and l.source='expedition' and l.bait_id='bait_first_greeting' and e.first_discovery
), tanks as materialized (
 select c.tank_id,count(*) occupants,
 count(*) filter(where s.is_native and s.native_region_id='mukhyang') ink,
 bool_or(s.id='muk-hyeonmu') hyeonmu,
 count(distinct s.id) filter(where s.kind='trash') trash,
 count(distinct s.native_region_id) filter(where s.rarity='mythic' and s.is_native) stars
 from public.player_collectibles c join public.collectible_species s on s.id=c.species_id
 where c.user_id=p_user and c.tank_id is not null and c.sold_at is null and c.escrow_gift_id is null group by c.tank_id
)
select jsonb_build_object(
 'rare_native_mythics',coalesce((select max(n) from (select count(distinct species_id) n from manual where rarity='mythic' and is_native and native_region_id=region_id group by region_id) x),0),
 'rare_foreign_mythic',(select count(*) from manual where rarity='mythic' and is_native and native_region_id<>region_id and native_collection_complete),
 'rare_trash_tank',coalesce((select max(trash) from tanks),0),
 'rare_ink_tank',(select count(*) from tanks where occupants>=10 and ink=occupants and hyeonmu),
 'rare_conch_new',(select count(*) from conch),
 'rare_last_miracle',(select count(*) from manual where rarity='mythic' and last_bait and first_discovery),
 'rare_last_legend',(select count(*) from manual where rarity='mythic' and last_mythic_discovery),
 'rare_stars_tank',coalesce((select max(stars) from tanks),0),
 'rare_all_seas',case when not exists(select 1 from public.regions r where not exists(select 1 from harbor h where h.region_id=r.id and h.is_native and h.native_region_id=r.id)) then 1 else 0 end,
 'rare_raft_new',(select count(distinct species_id) from harbor where vessel_id='fishing-raft' and first_discovery)
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.refresh_return_notifications()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor uuid:=auth.uid(); trip uuid; n integer:=0; next_at timestamptz;
begin
 if actor is null then raise exception 'AUTH_REQUIRED'; end if;
 for trip in select id from public.fishing_expeditions where user_id=actor and claimed_at is null
  and notified_at is null and returns_at<=clock_timestamp() order by returns_at,id limit 500
 loop n:=n+app_private.notify_due_expeditions(trip); end loop;
 for trip in select id from public.harbor_voyages where user_id=actor and claimed_at is null
  and notified_at is null and returns_at<=clock_timestamp() order by returns_at,id limit 500
 loop n:=n+app_private.notify_due_harbor_voyages(trip); end loop;
 for trip in select id from app_private.production_sites where user_id=actor
  and started_at is not null and ready_notified_at is null
  and completes_at<=clock_timestamp() and expires_at>clock_timestamp() order by completes_at,id limit 500
 loop n:=n+app_private.notify_due_production_sites(trip); end loop;
 select min(due_at) into next_at from (
  select returns_at as due_at from public.fishing_expeditions where user_id=actor and claimed_at is null and notified_at is null
  union all
  select returns_at from public.harbor_voyages where user_id=actor and claimed_at is null and notified_at is null
  union all
  select completes_at from app_private.production_sites where user_id=actor and started_at is not null
   and ready_notified_at is null and expires_at>clock_timestamp()
 ) pending;
 return jsonb_build_object('created',n,'nextAt',next_at,'serverNow',clock_timestamp());
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.savings_payload(a shell_savings, p_now timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select to_jsonb(a)||jsonb_build_object(
  'principal',a.daily_amount*a.paid_count,
  'bonusPercent',case a.term_days when 3 then 20 when 5 then 25 else 30 end,
  'expectedBonus',a.daily_amount*a.term_days*(case a.term_days when 3 then 20 when 5 then 25 else 30 end)/100,
  'expectedPayout',a.daily_amount*a.term_days*(case a.term_days when 3 then 120 when 5 then 125 else 130 end)/100,
  'maturesAt',a.started_at+make_interval(hours=>a.term_days*24),
  'nextOpenAt',case when a.paid_count<a.term_days then a.started_at+make_interval(hours=>a.paid_count*24) end,
  'depositDeadline',case when a.paid_count<a.term_days then a.started_at+make_interval(hours=>(a.paid_count+1)*24) end,
  'status',case
   when a.closed_at is not null then 'closed'
   when a.paid_count=a.term_days and p_now>=a.started_at+make_interval(hours=>a.term_days*24) then 'matured'
   when a.paid_count<a.term_days and p_now>=a.started_at+make_interval(hours=>(a.paid_count+1)*24) then 'missed'
   when a.paid_count<a.term_days and p_now>=a.started_at+make_interval(hours=>a.paid_count*24) then 'due'
   else 'waiting' end
 )
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.title_metrics(p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
with logs as materialized (
 select *,(occurred_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date play_day,(occurred_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::time local_time
 from app_private.title_fishing_log where user_id=p_user
), manual as materialized (
 select *,row_number() over(partition by play_day order by occurred_at,id) day_rank,
 sum((species_id is null)::integer) over(order by occurred_at,id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) failures,
 sum((kind='trash')::integer) over(order by occurred_at,id rows between 2 preceding and current row) trash_run,
 array_agg(species_id) over(order by occurred_at,id rows between 4 preceding and current row) last_species,
 array_agg(region_id) over(order by occurred_at,id rows between 4 preceding and current row) last_regions
 from logs where source='manual'
), care as materialized (
 select visitor_id,owner_id,(completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date play_day,'feed' action from public.aquarium_feedings where completed_at is not null and (visitor_id=p_user or owner_id=p_user)
 union all
 select visitor_id,owner_id,(completed_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date,'clean' from public.aquarium_cleanings where completed_at is not null and (visitor_id=p_user or owner_id=p_user)
), tanks as materialized (
 select c.tank_id,count(distinct s.native_region_id) filter(where s.is_native) natives,
 count(distinct s.id) filter(where s.kind='trash') trash,
 count(distinct s.id) filter(where s.kind='fish' and s.size<=45) small
 from public.player_collectibles c join public.collectible_species s on s.id=c.species_id
 where c.user_id=p_user and c.tank_id is not null and c.sold_at is null and c.escrow_gift_id is null group by c.tank_id
), arcade_counts as materialized (
 select (select count(*) from app_private.ladder_runs where user_id=p_user) ladder,
 (select count(*) from public.odd_even_runs where user_id=p_user) odd_even,
 (select count(*) from public.brick_game_runs where user_id=p_user) brick,
 (select count(*) from public.shadow_game_runs where user_id=p_user) shadow,
 (select count(*) from public.memory_game_runs where user_id=p_user) memory
), values_list(key,value) as (values
 ('arcade_ladder',(select ladder from arcade_counts)),
 ('arcade_odd_even',(select odd_even from arcade_counts)),
 ('arcade_brick',(select brick from arcade_counts)),
 ('arcade_shadow',(select shadow from arcade_counts)),
 ('arcade_memory',(select memory from arcade_counts)),
 ('arcade_total',(select ladder+odd_even+brick+shadow+memory from arcade_counts)),
 ('arcade_variety',(select (ladder>0)::int+(odd_even>0)::int+(brick>0)::int+(shadow>0)::int+(memory>0)::int from arcade_counts)),
 ('tailwind',(select count(*) from app_private.expedition_boosts where helper_id=p_user)),
 ('manual',(select count(*) from manual)),
 ('dawn',(select count(*) from manual where local_time>=time '02:00' and local_time<time '05:00')),
 ('mythic',(select count(*) from logs where rarity='mythic')),
 ('mythic_unique',(select count(distinct species_id) from logs where rarity='mythic')),
 ('trash',(select count(*) from logs where kind='trash')),
 ('decor',(select count(*) from logs where kind='decoration')),
 ('voyage',(select count(*) from public.fishing_expeditions where user_id=p_user and claimed_at is not null)),
 ('care',(select count(distinct (owner_id,play_day)) from care where visitor_id=p_user and owner_id<>p_user)),
 ('trade',(select count(*) from public.exchange_listings where (owner_id=p_user or taker_id=p_user) and status='completed')),
 ('quest',(select count(*) from app_private.quest_claims where user_id=p_user and period_kind='daily' and quest_id='all')),
 ('first_mythic',(select count(*) from manual where day_rank=1 and rarity='mythic')),
 ('last_rare',(select count(*) from manual where last_bait and rarity in ('rare','epic','mythic'))),
 ('after_failure',(select count(*) from manual where failures=5 and rarity in ('epic','mythic'))),
 ('triple_trash',(select count(*) from manual where trash_run=3)),
 ('five_species',(select count(*) from manual where cardinality(last_species)=5 and (select count(distinct s) from unnest(last_species) s)=5 and (select count(distinct r) from unnest(last_regions) r)=1)),
 ('midnight',(select count(*) from (select case when local_time>=time '23:55' then play_day+1 else play_day end from manual where local_time>=time '23:55' or local_time<time '00:05' group by 1 having bool_or(local_time>=time '23:55') and bool_or(local_time<time '00:05')) x)),
 ('daily_kinds',(select count(*) from (select play_day from logs where species_id is not null group by play_day having count(distinct kind) filter(where kind in ('fish','trash','decoration'))=3) x)),
 ('daily_rarities',(select count(*) from (select play_day from logs where species_id is not null group by play_day having count(distinct rarity)>=4) x)),
 ('five_baits',(select count(*) from (select play_day from manual group by play_day having count(distinct bait_id)>=5) x)),
 ('dinghy_mythic',(select count(*) from logs where source='expedition' and vessel_id='dinghy' and rarity='mythic')),
 ('double_mythic',(select count(*) from (select batch_id from logs where source='expedition' and rarity='mythic' group by batch_id having count(*)>=2) x)),
 ('fresh_gift',(select count(*) from public.collectible_gifts g where g.sender_id=p_user and g.source='friend' and exists(select 1 from manual m where m.collectible_id=any(g.collectible_ids) and m.play_day=(g.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date and m.occurred_at<=g.created_at))),
 ('mutual_care',(select count(*) from care a where a.visitor_id=p_user and a.owner_id<>p_user and exists(select 1 from care b where b.visitor_id=a.owner_id and b.owner_id=p_user and a.play_day=b.play_day))),
 ('three_neighbors',(select count(*) from (select play_day from (select play_day,owner_id from care where visitor_id=p_user and owner_id<>p_user group by play_day,owner_id having count(distinct action)=2) a group by play_day having count(*)>=3) b)),
 ('tank_native',(select count(*) from tanks where natives>=5)),
 ('tank_trash',(select count(*) from tanks where trash>=5)),
 ('tank_small',(select count(*) from tanks where small>=10)),
 ('friend_day_gift',(select count(*) from public.collectible_gifts g join public.friend_requests f on ((f.sender_id=p_user and f.recipient_id=g.recipient_id) or(f.recipient_id=p_user and f.sender_id=g.recipient_id))
 where g.sender_id=p_user and g.source='friend' and f.status='accepted' and (f.updated_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date=(g.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date and exists(select 1 from public.collectible_gifts b where b.source='friend' and b.sender_id=g.recipient_id and b.recipient_id=p_user and (b.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date=(g.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date)))
)
select jsonb_object_agg(key,value) from values_list
$function$

 from public.title_catalog c left join public.player_titles o on o.user_id=u and o.title_id=c.id));
